_comment: CT plan settings for SFT stage 2, DPO and decoding. SFT stage 1 uses a different calibration and no cap: see configs/plan_ct_stage1.json.

calibration.builder: python -m fora_report.plan.calibration_tiers --dense DENSE_LOGITS.npz --labels-npz LABELS.npz --split split.json --out calibration_train_platt.json --stats calibration_train_platt_stats.json

targets.builder: python -m fora_report.plan.targets --calibration calibration_train_platt.json --dense DENSE_LOGITS.npz --split split.json --out-dir TARGETS_DIR --plan-possible-cap 20 --plan-cap-rank prob
